verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Qdrant Private Cloud manages Qdrant database clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure. Qdrant also documents a distributed multi-peer mode and general deploy-anywhere guides. This implies official Kubernetes-managed deployment, but the pack never explicitly names a Helm chart or operator. Private Cloud appears to be a separate managed offering rather than the open-source path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official Helm chart or Kubernetes operator, its install and configuration steps, clarity on whether it is available without Private Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration of production Kubernetes deployments.
